goal: extend genuinely later-period fixed-S0 confirmation from 55 successful races to at least 100 successful races without tuning

acquisition.selection: whole accessible meeting/day blocks in source chronological order; no outcome-conditioned inclusion

decision_logic.continue: aggregate 100R fixed S0 remains better than uniform on all three primary metrics and calibration warning does not materially worsen across independent temporal blocks
decision_logic.mixed_or_fail: retain all negative evidence and do not repair on same evidence

after_100R_only: design a separately split calibration-development/calibration-confirmation experiment if probability reliability still warrants correction
